venira.output_kind: matched, summary, diagnoses[] {title, likely_cause, suggested_fix[], next_actions[]}.
venira.speed_profile: pure local rules, < 1 ms; no network and no model call.
venira.use_when: a command, build or provider call failed and the cause is unclear. Pass error_text or log_tail.

description:
Match an error or log tail against known failure signatures (TypeScript, Python, git, npm, GitHub, Venira codes) and return the likely cause, fixes and ready next_actions. Offline rules, no model call.
Use when: a command, build or provider call failed and the cause is unclear. Pass error_text or log_tail.
Avoid when: you already know the cause.
Output: matched, summary, diagnoses[] {title, likely_cause, suggested_fix[], next_actions[]}.

error_text.description: The error block (stderr, exception, compiler output). One of error_text/log_tail is required.

language.description: Optional language hint (typescript|python|rust|go|...) when the text does not show a file extension.

log_tail.description: Tail of the failing output (e.g. project_ci_logs / project_shell_status text). One of error_text/log_tail is required.
